"''Blik. Get away from them. We told you to stay away from street rats.|Blik and its mother about Colby and Niro|audio=StreetRats.mp3|}} During the [[Republic Era]],{{TalesDate|U4}} a [[Gender|female]] [[Duros]] was the '''mother''' of the [[youngling]] [[Blik]] and the partner of [[Blik's parent|another]] of its [[parent]]s. Between c. [[62 BBY]] and [[33 BBY]], the woman was present on the [[planet]] of [[Duro]] alongside their partner and their child. As the trio strolled the streets, Blik wandered away from its parents and attempted to chat up the Duros younglings [[Cad Bane|Colby]] and [[Niro]] as they caused trouble on the sidewalk. Blik's parents caught up with it before any conversation could unfold, with its mother telling it to get away from the "street [[rat]]s" as they approached their child. The woman also reminded their offspring that that they and their partner had instructed it not to hand around with such individuals. As the individual and their partner led their child away, Blik looked back at its peers, and its mother—also turning back—rushed it up with a pat on its shoulder. A [[Color|blue]]-skinned female Duros with red [[eye]]s and a stocky build, the mother wore close-fitting, [[earth]]-toned [[Clothing|garments]] with a belted waist. They had objections to their son hanging around with street children. ==Behind the scenes== Blik's mother first appeared in the "[[The Good Life]]," an episode of the animated miniseries ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld]]'', which was released on [[May 4]], [[2025]].{{SWYouTube|GkywNANueew|Tales of the Underworld | Official Trailer | Available May 4 on Disney+}} The character was voiced by [[Vanessa Marshall]], and was only identified as "Mother" in the credits. ==Appearances== *{{TOTU|The Good Life}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Blik's mother}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=ბლიკის დედა }} [[Category:Duros]] [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
